verdict.rationale: Elastic's first-party docs describe ready-to-use, vendor-maintained integrations covering Kubernetes clusters, VM hosts, containers, serverless and cloud services (400+/550+ integrations). Instrumentation runs through Elastic Agent managed centrally via Fleet, which can also run inside containers, plus Elastic's own OpenTelemetry distribution (EDOT). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of integration quality and coverage.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument hosts, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud services through vendor-maintained agents and integrations

citations.quote: Monitor Kubernetes clusters, VM hosts, and cloud services with ready-to-use integrations.
Monitor metrics from servers, virtual machines, containers, and serverless environments with over 400 out-of-the-box integrations, including OpenTelemetry.
Install an Elastic Agent and use Fleet to define, configure, and manage your agents in a central location.
Run an Elastic Agent inside of a container — either with Fleet Server or standalone.
Elastic Distributions of OpenTelemetry (EDOT) delivers production-ready collection with no vendor lock-in.
